questions.question: The Preamble to the Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on?
questions.explanation: Preamble was incorporated into the Constitution on 26 January 1950.

questions.question: Which of the following articles of the Constitution of India deals with the power of Parliament to amend the Constitution?
questions.explanation: Article 368 outlines the power of Parliament to amend the Constitution.

questions.question: The first West Bengal Legislative Assembly was constituted in?
questions.explanation: The first West Bengal Legislative Assembly was formed in 1952.

questions.question: Which of the following is a fundamental right under Article 19 of the Constitution of India?
options: Right to Freedom of Speech and Expression
questions.explanation: Article 19 guarantees the right to freedom of speech and expression.

questions.question: The Sixth Schedule of the Constitution of India applies to which of the following regions in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Sixth Schedule applies to the autonomous districts in the states of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram, except for the Darjeeling Gorkha Hill Council in West Bengal.

questions.question: Who was the President of the Indian National Congress in 1928 that passed the Purna Swaraj resolution?
questions.explanation: He was the key figure behind the resolution.

questions.question: Which of the following Bengali revolutionaries was instrumental in the formation of the Indian National Army (Azad Hind Fauj) during World War II?
questions.explanation: He led Azad Hind Fauj against the British.

questions.question: The Choupal Movement of 1919 was associated with which region in Bengal?
questions.explanation: The movement had a significant impact on tea plantations.

questions.question: The Champaran Satyagraha was led by which Indian leader in 1917 to protest against indigo plantation exploitation?
questions.explanation: Gandhi's first major satyagraha was in Champaran.

questions.question: Who wrote the influential Bengali novel 'Pather Panchali' in 1928 that portrayed rural Bengal?
questions.explanation: The novel was later adapted into a film by Satyajit Ray.

questions.question: Which of the following rivers is the main source of the Ganges River in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: Bhagirathi River is the main source of the Ganges River in West Bengal.

questions.question: What is the name of the highest peak in the Darjeeling Himalayan Hill Region of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: Sandakphu Peak is the highest peak in the Darjeeling Himalayan Hill Region of West Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following plains is located in the western part of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Ganges-Brahmaputra Plain is located in the western part of West Bengal.

questions.question: What is the name of the largest island in the Sundarbans Delta of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: Sagar Island is the largest island in the Sundarbans Delta of West Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following mountain ranges is located in the eastern part of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Naga Hills are located in the eastern part of West Bengal.

questions.question: The West Bengal government launched a new initiative to promote organic farming in the state. What is the name of this initiative?
questions.explanation: The initiative is called Sabuj Sathi.

questions.question: Which of the following schemes is implemented by the West Bengal government to provide financial assistance to women?
questions.explanation: The Kanyashree scheme provides financial assistance to women.

questions.question: The West Bengal government has set a target to increase the use of renewable energy in the state to what percentage by 2027?
questions.explanation: The target is to increase the use of renewable energy to 40% by 2027.

questions.question: The West Bengal government has launched a new project to improve the water quality of the Hooghly River. What is the name of this project?
questions.explanation: The project is called Swachh Hooghly Mission.

questions.question: The West Bengal government has announced to increase the minimum wage for unskilled workers in the state to what amount per day?
questions.explanation: The minimum wage will be increased to 150 per day.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the 'Swasthya Sathi' scheme launched by the Government of West Bengal?
options: To provide free medical treatment to poor patients
To increase private hospital investments in the state
questions.explanation: Swasthya Sathi aims to provide universal health insurance coverage.

questions.question: Which of the following social security schemes is implemented by the West Bengal Government?
questions.explanation: Kanyashree Prakalpa aims to promote girl child education and prevent child marriage.

questions.question: What is the main objective of the 'Duare Dastak' campaign initiated by the Government of West Bengal?
options: To enhance civic awareness about COVID-19 vaccination
To increase agricultural production in the state
questions.explanation: Duare Dastak aimed to increase COVID-19 vaccination coverage among rural population.

questions.question: Which of the following schemes is implemented by the West Bengal Government to promote employment and entrepreneurship?
questions.explanation: Yuvashree aims to provide financial assistance to unemployed youth.

questions.question: What is the primary focus of the 'Pathashree' scheme launched by the Government of West Bengal?
options: To enhance quality of education in government schools
To improve sanitation and hygiene in urban areas
To provide skill training to urban youth
questions.explanation: Pathashree aims to improve quality of education in government schools.

questions.question: In a shop at Howrah, a product is being sold at a 15% discount. If the original price of the product is Rs. 1,800, what is the selling price?
questions.explanation: Selling price is 85% of original price.

questions.question: A tea stall owner in Kolkata buys tea leaves at a cost price of Rs. 80 per kg. He sells it at a 25% profit. What is the selling price of the tea leaves per kg?
questions.explanation: Selling price is 125% of cost price.

questions.question: A shopkeeper at Esplanade market buys a product at a cost price of Rs. 2,400 and sells it at a 12% loss. What is the selling price?
questions.explanation: Selling price is 88% of original price.

questions.question: A person buys a product at an 18% discount and pays Rs. 810 for it. What is the original price of the product?
questions.explanation: Original price is 100% of selling price.

questions.question: A shop at Sealdah market sells a product at a 10% profit. If the selling price is Rs. 1,620, what is the cost price?
questions.explanation: Cost price is 100/110 of selling price.

questions.question: A pipe can fill 1/4th of a tank in 5 minutes. How long will it take to fill the entire tank?
questions.explanation: Time taken to fill the entire tank is the reciprocal of the rate of work.

questions.question: Two persons A and B can finish a work in 12 days and 16 days respectively. How long will it take for both of them working together to finish the work?
questions.explanation: The combined rate of work is the sum of individual rates of work.

questions.question: A cistern can be filled by a pipe A in 12 hours and by pipe B in 18 hours. How long will it take to fill the cistern if both pipes work together?
questions.explanation: The combined rate of work is the sum of individual rates of work.

questions.question: A tap can fill 1/3rd of a tank in 20 minutes. How long will it take to fill the entire tank?
questions.explanation: Time taken to fill the entire tank is the reciprocal of the rate of work.

questions.question: Four men can finish a piece of work in 48 hours. How long will it take for three men to finish the work?
questions.explanation: The rate of work is inversely proportional to the number of workers.

questions.question: A train travels from Howrah Junction to Sealdah, a distance of 20 km in 25 minutes. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.explanation: Speed is calculated as distance divided by time in hours.

questions.question: A man travels from Kolkata to Asansol, a distance of 170 km in 5 hours. If he walks at the same speed, how much distance will he cover in 2 hours?
questions.explanation: Distance covered is equal to speed multiplied by time.

questions.question: A car covers a distance of 240 km in 4 hours. If it travels at the same speed, how much time will it take to cover a distance of 400 km?
questions.explanation: Time taken is equal to distance divided by speed.

questions.question: A bus travels from Siliguri to Jalpaiguri, a distance of 120 km in 3 hours. If it increases its speed by 20 km/h, how much time will it take to cover the same distance?
questions.explanation: Time taken is inversely proportional to speed.

questions.question: A cyclist travels from Darjeeling to Kalimpong, a distance of 80 km in 4 hours. If he covers half the distance in 2 hours, what is his speed in the second half?
questions.explanation: Speed is calculated as distance divided by time.

questions.question: A is the son of B's mother's brother. How is A related to B?
questions.explanation: A is the son of B's maternal uncle.

questions.question: If I am the brother of your mother's sister, how am I related to you?
questions.explanation: I am your maternal uncle.

questions.question: If I am the son of your father's sister, how am I related to you?
questions.explanation: I am your paternal aunt's child.

questions.question: A is the daughter of B's mother's sister. How is A related to B?
questions.explanation: A is the daughter of B's maternal aunt.

questions.question: If I am the son of your mother's brother, how am I related to you?
questions.explanation: I am your maternal uncle's child.

questions.question: A man is standing at a crossroad with a post office on his left and a bank on his right. He walks 20 meters towards the bank, turns right and walks 10 meters. Then he turns left and walks 15 meters. In which direction is he from the post office?
questions.explanation: He ended up walking towards the bank first, then turned, and walked away from the post office.

questions.question: A man is facing south and moves 50 meters, then turns right and moves 25 meters. He then turns left and moves 30 meters. In which direction is he from the point where he first started?
questions.explanation: He initially moved south, turned right, moved east, and then turned left, moving north.

questions.question: A tourist is at the Howrah Bridge in Kolkata and heads north. After crossing the river, he turns right and walks 5 kilometers. Then he turns left and walks 3 kilometers. In which direction is he from the Sealdah Railway Station?
questions.explanation: He initially moved north, then turned right and moved east, before finally turning left and moving west.

questions.question: A person is at the Dakshineswar Kali Temple and faces the Ganges River. He walks 150 meters towards the river, then turns left and walks 75 meters. Then he turns right and walks 200 meters. In which direction is he from the Kali Temple?
questions.explanation: He initially moved towards the river, turned left, and then turned right, walking away from the temple.

questions.question: A man is at the BBD Bagh in Kolkata and walks 20 meters north. Then he turns right and walks 15 meters. Finally, he turns left and walks 25 meters. In which direction is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: He initially moved north, turned right and moved east, before finally turning left and moving west.

questions.question: If 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, ? are the next three numbers in the series, then which number should come next?
questions.explanation: The series is formed by adding 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and so on.

questions.question: Which number will replace the question mark in the series: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
questions.explanation: The pattern is increasing square of natural numbers.

questions.question: What should replace the question mark in the series: 3, 6, 12, 24, 48, ?
questions.explanation: The pattern is obtained by multiplying the previous term by 2.

questions.question: In the series: A, B, C, D, E, F, which letter will replace the question mark?
questions.explanation: The series is obtained by replacing each alphabet with the next one in the English alphabet.

questions.question: If 5, 10, 20, 35, 55, ? are the next two numbers in the series, then which number should come next?
questions.explanation: The series is formed by adding 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, and so on.
